links.outcome: Eligibility classification accuracy of LLM pipeline versus rule-based extractor comparator on hold-out set
links.effect: LLM-based pipeline achieved 94% accuracy and Cohen's kappa 0.90, significantly surpassing the rule-based comparator (80% accuracy).
links.quote: The LLM-based pipeline achieved 94% accuracy and a Cohen's kappa of 0.90 on the hold-out set, significantly surpassing the rule-based comparator (80% accuracy) and demonstrating performance comparable to human experts.

links.outcome: Accuracy against expert consensus on independent hold-out set of local memory clinic reports
links.effect: Optimized on development set (n = 97) and evaluated on independent hold-out set (n = 99); 94% accuracy, kappa 0.90 against expert consensus.
links.quote: In a two-stage design, LLM-based extraction prompts, a deterministic rule-based extractor, and a shared downstream rule-based classifier were optimized on a development set (n = 97) and evaluated on an independent hold-out set (n = 99), with expert consensus as ground truth.

unlisted_practices: On-premises open-weights LLM deployment to preserve patient data privacy

screen.reason: The study evaluates an on-premises open-weights LLM pipeline for extracting clinical variables and screening lecanemab eligibility on retrospective memory clinic reports against expert consensus, but it does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice comparative intervention.
